input.summary:
Drying lean-to furnished (parts/room-4.mjs, 14 blocks via layers()): two candle racks on the east side (dark-oak fence uprights, trapdoor shelves, lit white_candle clusters) as the focal piece, tallow barrels with lit candles at the back-west, two hanging lanterns over the racks.
make.sh is green with no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE lines; $MCD room says OK: 26 of 26 floor cells reachable, min light 10, 0 dark cells.
The lantern-support and rack-collision problems below depend on the Grounds part, which is still a stub here.
left: The two hanging lanterns at (17,3,20) and (17,3,23) hang from the lean-to slab roof at y=4 (Grounds part). `mcd check` reports them UNSUPPORTED until that roof is built; if the roof never lands they float.

Candle racks at x=17 (z 19..24) and the barrels at x=15 may collide with Grounds' own leanToBay posts or candleRack calls (posts at x=18, z=18/21/24). Any overlapping cell is refused in runParts and will be reported by the merge; the designer's layout is otherwise unaffected.
The lean-to floor (podzol and coarse_dirt) sits at y=0, outside this room's box, so it is not written here; it belongs to Grounds.
Elements.md's 'Drying lean-to with racks' item is shared with P6 and stays unticked: the posts, roof and racks are Grounds' to build.

waste.what: Worked out each rack's cells, shelf trapdoor and candle heights, and the lane clearance by hand, with the walk checked only after the first make.sh.
waste.cost: about 4 reasoning passes and 1 make.sh + room check round; no retries needed
waste.tool: A `mcd room --suggest-layout` (or a plan mode that prints lane cells and free rack slots) would have fixed the layout in one pass.

waste.what: I could not use candleRack() for the lit racks, because it hardcodes lit:false, so I drew the racks as text with layers() instead.
waste.cost: one extra legend and one extra layer of text; no retries
waste.tool: candleRack(g,x,y,z,{candles, lit}) should accept opts.lit (default false).

waste.what: Hanging lanterns need a roof block above them, but the roof is another part's work, so I could not check their support until a later make.sh.
waste.cost: one unsupported-attachment warning that cannot be cleared from inside this part
waste.tool: A `mcd check --after-parts` or dependency note that says which earlier part supplies the support would have flagged this before the merge.

companions.task: Build the lean-to's shed roof (dark_oak_slab course at y=4 to y=5 over x=15..18, z=18..24) before the lanterns are hung, so the lanterns have a block above them.
Place and check the light levels: the lantern spots and candle clusters, to keep every floor cell at 8 or more and the focal racks brightest.
Stack and fill the tallow barrels and set their open or closed states at the back of the lean-to.
